etymology: English: the stream - named for something that is consumed rather than entered.
carriers: An infinite scroll, a recommendation model, a phone at two in the morning, and the sixty seconds after a strong emotion.
economics: Attention sold forward. The audience is the inventory, and the inventory is priced by how much of it can be held.
signature: The next item is already loaded, and it is angrier than the last one.

confused_with.tell: The comment section is under a thing somebody made; the feed is the thing, and nobody made it.

senses: The habitat that chooses its own inhabitants: a place with no address, no closing time, and an editor that is a model trained on what you paused on.

It works because it is not a venue but a selection pressure. Nothing in the feed has to be true, or even popular in general; it only has to keep one person on the page, and the person most likely to stay is the one who has just been made angry.
example: *"He opened the app to check the weather, and the **feed** gave him a war, a grievance, and a supplement in ninety seconds."*
